lines: d39: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ruby Young is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d39: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d39: 🕯️ Ruby is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d39: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d39: 🕯️ Ruby Young is dead — contest. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d39: What Ruby kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d39: "Ruby's gone." Miguel looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ruby." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d39: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Darius blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d39: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 1). You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
d39: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d39: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Ruby Young, 39 days. The mantle passes to Darius Yoon.
d39: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Darius Yoon, 27 — a paramedic. His hands know different work now: The Touch, Lucky Rock, War Cry, Green Whisper, Bloodhound.
d39: The village's quarrel was with Ruby — and Ruby is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d39: At the grave, Miguel, Rebecca, Xiaojuan and 5 more speak for Darius — "Ruby trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d39: The fire knew Darius before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.

d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Darius is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d40: 🕯️ Darius Yoon is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Darius kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Darius's gone." Xiaojuan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Darius." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Miguel blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.

d40: 📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Haymaker (Level 1). One big swing. Everything you have, all at once. Subtlety is for people with time.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Darius Yoon, 40 days. The mantle passes to Miguel Morozov.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Miguel Morozov, 55 — a hunting guide. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Berserker Rage, Dowsing, Green Whisper, Adrenaline Control.
d40: At the grave, Rebecca, Xiaojuan, Milana and 4 more speak for Miguel — "Darius trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Miguel before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d47: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Miguel Morozov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d47: 🕯️ Miguel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d47: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d47: 🕯️ Miguel's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)

d47: 📖 LEARNED: Wiring & Circuits (Level 1). Volts, amps, and why you respect both. Safe splices, real grounds, no shortcuts.
d47: 📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.
